decisive_items: Doughy skin with palpable bilateral piezogenic papules
Increased range of motion in elbows, hips, and knees with normal strength
response.rationale: Generalized joint hypermobility, doughy skin with piezogenic papules, pes planus, umbilical hernia, scoliosis, and chronic musculoskeletal pain are most consistent with Ehlers-Danlos syndrome; normal aortic measurements and unremarkable MRA argue against Marfan and Loeys-Dietz.

rejected.why: Family history of cerebral aneurysm raises Loeys-Dietz, but unremarkable MRA with no aneurysms and absence of LDS-specific craniofacial or arterial features make it less likely.
Marfan shares skeletal and ocular features, but normal aortic measurements and tricuspid aortic valve contradict the required aortic phenotype, and doughy skin/piezogenic papules are not typical.
